name: Boom Town
eventSubtitle: Property prices bounce back!
eventDescription: Move to any property space. Tap this card then the property card to buy it, auction it or raise rent level +1.

name: Crime Down
eventSubtitle: Police arrest local newspaper thief!
eventDescription: Tap this card then one of your property cards. (Colour set rent level jumps +1)

name: Deal Of The Week
eventSubtitle: Word on the street says the market is booming!
eventDescription: Move to any property space. Tap this card then the property card to buy it, auction it or raise rent level +1.

name: Demolished
eventSubtitle: Your builders get the wrong address!
eventDescription: Tap this card then any property card. (Rent level resets to 1)

name: Grand Designs
eventSubtitle: One of your properties gets a TV makeover!
eventDescription: Tap this card then one of your property cards. (Rent level jumps to 5)

name: Haunted House
eventSubtitle: Something strange is going on! Swap another player's property with one of yours.
eventDescription: Pick another player. Tap this card then you each tap one of your property cards to swap. Exchange cards too!
notes: Requires two property scans (one per player) after player selection.

name: Highway Tax
eventSubtitle: Your roads need repairs!
eventDescription: Tap this card then your Bank card to pay M50 per property you own.
notes: Card uses Monopoly currency symbol before 50.

name: House Party
eventSubtitle: The good times go on till late!
eventDescription: Tap this card then one of your property cards. (Rent level jumps to +1 for you; drops -1 for your neighbours)
notes: Printed rule confirmed. Engine semantics for 'neighbours' not yet defined.

name: In The Money
eventSubtitle: Spend your lottery millions! Swap another player's property with one of yours.
eventDescription: Pick another player. Tap this card then you each tap one of your property cards to swap. Exchange cards too!
notes: Requires two property scans (one per player) after player selection.

name: It's A Boy!
eventSubtitle: Your new arrival wakes up the whole street!
eventDescription: Tap this card then one of your property cards. (Rent level jumps to +1 for you; drops -1 for your neighbours)
notes: Printed rule confirmed. Engine semantics for 'neighbours' not yet defined.

name: Love Is In The Air
eventSubtitle: Meet someone special right up your street!
eventDescription: Pick another player. Tap this card then both your Bank cards to collect M200.
notes: Both players receive 200. Requires two player card scans.

name: On The Map
eventSubtitle: The new railway station gets the go-ahead!
eventDescription: Tap this card then one of your property cards. (Colour set rent level jumps +1)

name: On The Run
eventSubtitle: The summer marathon shuts down the roads!
eventDescription: Tap this card. (Players pay level 1 rent only for the next two rent payments)
notes: Printed rule confirmed. Engine tracking for 'next two rent payments' not yet defined.

name: Pick Your Own
eventSubtitle: Catch someone stealing your prize tomatoes!
eventDescription: Tap this card and send another player to Jail.

name: Pong! What A Stinker
eventSubtitle: The local sewer springs a leak!
eventDescription: Tap this card then one of your property cards. (Rent level drops -1 for that side of the board)
notes: Printed rule confirmed. Engine semantics for 'that side of the board' not yet defined.

name: Rover's Revenge
eventSubtitle: Your pet pooch poops on someone's patio!
eventDescription: Tap this card then any property card. (Rent level resets to 1)

name: Stargazing
eventSubtitle: The hottest A-list celebrity moves in next door!
eventDescription: Tap this card then one of your property cards. (Colour set rent level jumps +1)

name: Stop The Presses
eventSubtitle: Get the lowdown on a hot property!
eventDescription: Move to any property space. Tap this card then the property card to buy it, auction it or raise rent level +1.

name: 'Tis The Season
eventSubtitle: You've caught that nasty cough going around!
eventDescription: Tap this card then one of your property cards. (Colour set rent level drops -1)

name: Tornado Alley
eventSubtitle: Hey, where did the roof go?
eventDescription: Tap this card then any property card. (Rent level resets to 1)

name: Total Gridlock
eventSubtitle: Faulty traffic lights get the street in a jam!
eventDescription: Tap this card and all players move directly to Free Parking. Do not pass GO! If you are in Jail, stay there!
notes: Printed rule confirmed. Version 1: physical board/tokens remain authoritative for position; app displays instruction, blocks GO payment, preserves Jail state, and players manually move eligible tokens to Free Parking. No digital board movement.

name: What A Ride!
eventSubtitle: Your local theme park builds the world's craziest roller-coaster!
eventDescription: Tap this card then one of your property cards. (Rent level jumps +1 for that side of the board)
notes: Printed rule confirmed. Engine semantics for 'that side of the board' not yet defined.

name: Wibble Wobble
eventSubtitle: Sit in a bath of jelly with a friend for charity!
eventDescription: Pick another player. Tap this card then both your Bank cards to collect M200.
notes: Both players receive 200. Requires two player card scans.
